items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: And that's me. This fella by the name of Foster Petty was a piano player. This fella was Zito, a guitar player. This is a little Serge, you know, a little Serge. Stan Serge? Stan Serge on the drum.

ctx.x: He's the same guy that's back in town, not a bass player, huh?

Yeah. That's a band that played around here, over the river. Different spots. Well, I front that band for about three or four years. Then I come back off the road, and I went out to Pontchartrain Beach. Here's a picture here with Harry Shields. That's a terrible-looking picture, but that's the way we looked in them days. Yeah. Like we were hungry. We were on a panic. That's Harry there. That's Harry there. That's Harry there. And that's me. This fella by the name of Foster Petty was a piano player. This fella was…
